acme/pixelkit#1.title: Crash on import after upgrading to 2.3.0

project.name: pixelkit
project.description: A small image processing library for Python.

issue.title: Crash on import after upgrading to 2.3.0
issue.body:
After upgrading from 2.2.4 to 2.3.0 `import pixelkit` raises ImportError: cannot import name 'resize_fast'.

Steps:
1. python -m venv env && source env/bin/activate
2. pip install pixelkit==2.3.0
3. python -c 'import pixelkit'

Python 3.11, Ubuntu 22.04. Nothing works for me until I downgrade.

issue.title: Rotate drops EXIF orientation
issue.body:
After `rotate(90)` the EXIF orientation tag is lost. Workaround: call `fix_exif()` before saving.

Repro:
```python
im = pixelkit.open('a.jpg')
im = im.rotate(90)
im.save('b.jpg')
```
